reviewer: TrueWay vision audit - visual inspection of every source photograph via contact sheets
method: Every distinct source photograph in ml/dataset was inspected VISUALLY, not judged from its Commons title. A photograph is APPROVED only if it depicts the named POI (or the named distractor category) in a way a visitor's own photograph of that place would plausibly resemble.

verdict_meanings.approved: Usable as a vision reference; included in training / calibration / test.
verdict_meanings.rejected: Must not be used: does not depict the labelled subject, is not a photograph of the subject, is an archival or graphic artefact, or is out of region.
verdict_meanings.pending: Not yet reviewed; treated as unusable for training and reported as unreviewed.

notes: 1 classes end up with ZERO approved photographs and must be re-harvested with human-verified allow-lists: neg-generic-indian-temple. An empty class is worse than no class, because it teaches the model that the subject is a negative.

The hardest negative class for this circuit - brick stupas and excavated brick ruins that genuinely resemble Nalanda Temple 3 - is effectively absent: neg-ordinary-brick-ruins contains brick WALL TEXTURES, not ruins.
in-bihar-bodhgaya-mucalinda and in-bihar-nalanda-museum contain weak or archival material and should be re-harvested too.
